plan.seed_method: 512 distinct random uint32 seeds above 2.8 billion, drawn after freezing all five models; excludes the earlier study and prompt experiment serves.
plan.selection: Small was selected on development results before this plan. All five retained models are compared; these results select no checkpoint.

metadata_revision.note: File checksums updated for a descriptive method-metadata revision. Frozen networks, selection, seeds and match outcomes are unchanged.

rally_interval_method: 95% percentile bootstrap of mean rally score; 4096 resamples of serve seeds, keeping both sides and all five rallies together. Measures serve-set uncertainty, not variation between training runs.
league_interval_method: 95% percentile bootstrap; 5000 resamples of whole paired serve sets, using 1/0.5/0 for a set win/draw/loss. Describes serve-set uncertainty, not training variation.
